frequency_question: Among cases where a bilateral cooperation agreement or major arms transfer is submitted to the legislature under a statutory window for a joint resolution of disapproval, how often does the legislature successfully pass such a resolution and overcome or avoid a presidential veto?
membership_rule: Includes all formal notifications of major international agreements or military sales submitted to the legislature under statutory frameworks allowing a joint resolution of disapproval within a defined window. Excludes informal consultations or treaties requiring standard two-thirds Senate ratification.
window: Statutory review windows ranging from 30 to 90 days, assessed within historical legislative sessions.
